about.title: Ibijanye
about.intro: {project} ni urubuga rwo gusangiza amadosiye ya peer-to-peer rwo mu ruhuko rwikuriraga rwubatswe ku ikoranabuhanga rishasha ridafise ikibanza co hagati. Iboneka interface y'umukoresha yoroshe hamwe n'iyubakwa ridafise ikibanza co hagati ryuzuye, itanga umuti urinze kandi wizigiwe wo gusangiza amakuru utisuganira mu nyungu zo hagati izo ari zo zose. Umugambi ni open source kandi ukwiragizwa hashingiwe kuri {license}.

decentralized.title: Urusobe ruzuye rudafise ikibanza co hagati
decentralized.description: Nta serveri zo hagati, nta hantu hamwe ho gukubita. Abakoresha barashakisha kandi bakuramo ibirimwo bafise n'umutima ku giti cabo, batisuganira mu basinya bo hagati, abazikurikirana canke za database.

accessControl.title: Igenzura ryeranda ryo kwinjira
accessControl.description: Umuntu wose afise uburenganzira bwo gutangiza urusobe rwiwe afise amategeko yiwe. Donsa amabuye y'umukoresha muri buri rusobe: abanyenezo, abayobozi, abasohora, abagenzura n'abakuramo. Genzura neza uwurusobe ushobora gusohora, kugenzura no kuramo ibirimwo.

ui.title: Interface y'umukoresha y'urwego rwo hejuru
ui.description: Interface y'ikibanza c'ibimenyeshamakuru ihagaze neza kandi yoroshe ku mukoresha yatanguzwa kuri madesktop, televiziyo n'amatelefone agendanwa. Nyabuna nta nkomyi ukoresheje keyboard, imbeba, gamepad canke uburyo bwo kuyobora bwa kure. Abakoresha b'inkomezi barashobora gukoresha interface y'umurongo w'amabwirizwa kugira bakoreshe porogarama nka serveri y'amadosiye idafise umutwe.

dataFormat.title: Imiterere y'amakuru isomwa n'umuntu
dataFormat.description: Imiterere y'amakuru ya LISH ishingiye kuri JSON, igatuma bituma byoroshe gukora, gusoma no gutahura. Sangiza ibirimwo vyawe na metadata zihagaze neza, zibonekana umuntu wose ashobora kurabira yitonze.

security.title: Ibanga n'umutekano
security.description: Itumanaho ryose rya peer-to-peer ryasubirwamwo na encrypt, kugira ngo amakuru yawe abandanye kuba ibanga mu gihe yarungikwa. Abakoresha barashobora kwihisha inyuma ya VPN ku rwego rwiyongera rwo kutamenyekana. {project} yubahiriza ibanga ryawe muburyo bwo gukora.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Porogarama iraboneka kuri Windows, Linux na macOS. Ikoreshe kuri buri gikoresho ushaka.

download.title: Kuramo
download.description: Bona {project} kuri platform yawe. Bose bakuramo ku buntu kandi ni open source.
